sentences.speaker: Speaker

sentences.translation: 过了一段时间，当地人又提出了另一个建议，这个建议并不是项目最初提议的一部分，但后来也被采纳了。他们决定尝试建立蜂群，提供蜂蜜供自己食用同时也销售。

fragments.text: In Chicualacuala, there was a marked improvement in agricultural production, which improved food security and benefited local people by providing them with both food and income.
